However, my lashes do not look at all natural after applying it - the lashes stick/cling together and create a rubbery look. reviews.title: Tubing Not Good for Everyone

So I ordered the mascara, except it was this one that has tiny black chunks of mascara that stick to lashes and look like bad, clumping mascara. That is very bad for patients with ongoing irritated eyes, especially when the clumps get into the eyes. I had to stop using it, almost new, because of this. reviews.title: Clumps and flakes off
reviews.body: I've worn this twice, the first time, I dipped the brush once and added three coats to my lashes and it started clumping by the third coat. This made it flake after a few hours. Second time, I loaded up the brush and only did two coats on my lashes and it looked better, less clumpy, but it still flaked after about 4 hours of wear. Not great for the price.

It was clearly defective yet Thrive acted like they were doing me a big favor replacing the tube even though the “return window” expired.

reviews.title: Worse mascara I've ever used.
reviews.body: Worse mascara I've ever used. Very clumpy right at initial use. Just globs out of the tube and smudges instantly. Complete waste of money, threw it in the trash!

reviews.author: Mandy L.
reviews.title: Product is too clumpy
reviews.body: Unfortunately I would not recommend this product to anyone. It’s super clumpy and makes my lashes look bad. I have long fluffy eyelashes that typically look very nice with mascara on. Maybe it’s the brush for applying that makes this product not go on well. I’ve used it a handful of times now and each time I regret putting it on and have to spend way longer than I’d like trying to make it look half way decent. I don’t like leaving reviews that aren’t positive, but for the amount of advertising and marketing I’ve seen about this companies mascara you would hope it’s actually a really good quality product.
